body.name: explicit nonvanishing family
body.construction:
Set the latent coordinates independent and uniform. For a selected row \(j=s(a,k)\), let \(A_{a,k}=\operatorname{pa}_{\Gamma}(j)\cap\{\rho_a(1),\ldots,\rho_a(k-1)\}\). For each \(v\in\mathcal Q^{A_{a,k}}\), choose a strictly positive probability vector \(b_{a,k,v}\) and a number \(\eta_{a,k,v}>0\), small enough that all entries below are positive, and define the compatible measurement table by
\[
 P(X_j=x\mid H_{\operatorname{pa}_{\Gamma}(j)}=h)
 =b_{a,k,h_{A_{a,k}}}(x)
 +\eta_{a,k,h_{A_{a,k}}}\bigl(\mathbf 1\{x=h_{\rho_a(k)}\}-q^{-1}\bigr).
\]
Equivalently, the induced local matrix is \(B_{a,k,u}=b_{a,k,u_{A_{a,k}}}\mathbf 1^{\mathsf T}+\eta_{a,k,u_{A_{a,k}}}Q_q\); thus both \(b\) and \(\eta\) are constant when only nonparent coordinates of \(u\) change. Assign arbitrary strictly positive graph-compatible tables to unselected observed rows.
